europe_now.title: US-Mediated Ukraine Peace Talks
europe_now.summary: Delegations from Ukraine and Russia are holding a second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi following constructive initial discussions that included a potential prisoner swap deal.

europe_now.title: Espionage Arrest in Britain
europe_now.summary: British counterterrorism police and US authorities have arrested a US soldier in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence and involvement in a terror plot.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Peace Negotiations
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian and Russian representatives are continuing diplomatic negotiations in Abu Dhabi facilitated by the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged European nations to swiftly designate their representative for the ongoing peace process.

top_stories.title: Security and Espionage Investigations
top_stories.summary: British counterterrorism police arrested a US soldier on suspicion of aiding Russian intelligence. Meanwhile, US authorities charged three individuals in connection with a security plot targeting an RAF facility.
